title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Acts 12: Peter led out of prison by an angel, the house of Mary, and the end of King Herod.

questions.text: Whom did King Herod kill with the sword?
questions.explanation: Acts 12:2 says he killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

answers.text: Peter
James
Blastus
Mark

questions.text: To how many squads of soldiers was Peter delivered in prison?
questions.explanation: Herod put Peter in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him.

answers.text: Four squads of four soldiers each
Two squads of six soldiers each
Three squads of four soldiers each
Six squads of two soldiers each

questions.text: How was Peter sleeping on the night before Herod meant to bring him out?
questions.explanation: He was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, while guards kept the door.

answers.text: Alone, with his feet in the stocks
Chained to the iron gate of the prison
In an open courtyard with the other prisoners
Between two soldiers, bound with two chains

questions.text: What happened when the angel struck Peter on the side and woke him?
questions.explanation: The angel told him to stand up quickly, and his chains fell off his hands.

answers.text: The whole prison was shaken
The guards fell into a deep sleep
His chains fell off his hands
The walls of the cell were broken open

questions.text: What happened at the iron gate that leads into the city?
questions.explanation: They came to the iron gate leading into the city, and it opened to them by itself.

answers.text: It opened to them by itself
The angel unlocked it with a key
Peter climbed over it in the dark
The guards opened it at the angel's word

questions.text: Whose house did Peter come to after the angel departed from him?
questions.explanation: He came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered and praying.

answers.text: The house of James, the brother of John
The house of Rhoda the servant girl
The house of Mary, the mother of John called Mark
The house of Blastus, the king's aide

questions.text: Who came to answer when Peter knocked at the door of the gate?
questions.explanation: A servant girl named Rhoda came to answer, and she recognized Peter's voice.

answers.text: Mary, the mother of John Mark
A servant girl named Rhoda
One of the soldiers from the prison
James, to whom Peter sent word

questions.text: What message did Peter leave before he departed and went to another place?
questions.explanation: He declared how the Lord had brought him out of the prison and said that these things should be told to James and to the brothers.

answers.text: To meet him again in Antioch
To say nothing at all to anyone
To go down with him to Caesarea
To tell these things to James and to the brothers

questions.text: What did Herod do when he had sought Peter and did not find him?
questions.explanation: He examined the guards and then commanded that they should be put to death.

answers.text: He examined the guards and had them put to death
He set free the rest of the prisoners
He went up to Jerusalem for the Passover
He promised silver to whoever found Peter

questions.text: What happened to Herod after the people shouted, "The voice of a god, and not of a man!"?
questions.explanation: An angel of the Lord struck him because he did not give God the glory, and he was eaten by worms and died.

answers.text: He tore his royal clothing and repented
He gave God the glory before the people
An angel of the Lord struck him, and he died
He fled from Caesarea to Tyre
